arabic_text: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْألُكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ الَّتِي وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَيٍْء وَبِقُوَّتِكَ الَّتِي قَهَرْتَ بِهَا كُلَّ شَيٍْء وَخَضَعَ لَهَا كُلُّ شَيٍْء
transliteration: bismillāh al-raḥmān al-raḥīm allāhumma innī as'aluka bi-raḥmatika allatī wasiʿat kulla shay'in wa biquwwatika allati qaharta biha kulla shay'in wa-khaḍaʿa lahā kullu shay-in
english_text: In the Name of Allah, the All-merciful, the All-compassionate O Allah, I ask You by Your mercy, which “..embraces all things” (7:156), And by Your strength, through which You dominate all things, And toward which all things are humble

arabic_text: وَذَلَّ لَهَا كُلُّ شَيٍْء
transliteration: wa dhal-la la-ha kullu shay'in
english_text: And before which all things are lowly;

arabic_text: وَبِجَبرُوتِكَ الَّتِي غَلَبْتَ بِهَا كُلَّ شَيٍْء وَبِعِزَّتِكَ الَّتِي لا يَقُومُ لَهَا شَيْءٌ
transliteration: wa bi jabrūtika allatī ghalabta bihā kulla shay'in wa bi'izzatika allati la yaqumu laha shay'un
english_text: And by Your invincibility through which You overwhelm all things, And by Your might, which nothing can resist;

arabic_text: وَبِعَظَمَتِكَ الَّتِي مَلَأَتْ كُلَّ شَيٍْء
transliteration: wa biʿaẓamatika allatī malā't kulla shay'in
english_text: And by Your tremendousness, which has filled all things;

arabic_text: وَبِسُلْطَانِكَ الَّذِي عَلاَ كُلَّ شَيٍْء
transliteration: wa bisulṭānik-al-ladhī ʿalā kulla shay'in
english_text: by Your force, which towers over all things;

arabic_text: وَبِوَجْهِكَ الْبَاقِي بَعْدَ فَنَاءِ كُلِّ شَيٍْء وَبِأَسْمَائِكَ الَّتِي مَلَأَتْ أَرْكَانَ كُلِّ شَيٍْء
transliteration: wa biwajhikal-baqī ba'da fana'i kulli shay'in. wa bi-asmā'ika allatī mal'at arkāna kulli shay'in
english_text: And by Your face, which subsists after the annihilation of all things, And by Your Names, which have filled the foundations of all things;

arabic_text: وَبِعِلْمِكَ الَّذِي أَحَاطَ بِكُلِّ شَيٍْء
transliteration: wa biʿilmika alladhī aḥāṭa bikulli shay'in
english_text: And by Your knowledge, which encompasses all things;

arabic_text: وَبِنُورِ وَجْهِكَ الَّذِي أَضَاءَ لَهُ كُلُّ شَيٍْء
transliteration: wa bi-nūri wajhika alladhī aḍā'a lahu kullu shay'in
english_text: And by the light of Your face, through which all things are illumined!

arabic_text: يَّا نُورُ يَا قُدُّوسُ
transliteration: yā nūru yā quddūs
english_text: O Light! O All-holy!

arabic_text: يَا أَوَّلَ الأَوَّلِينَ وَيَا آخِرَ الآخِرِينَ
transliteration: yā ʾawwal al-awwalīn wa yā ākhira al-ākhīrīn
english_text: O First of those who are first And O Last of those who are last!

arabic_text: اَللَّهُمَ اغْفِرْ لِي الذُّنُوبَ الَّتِي تَهتِكُ الْعِصَمَ
transliteration: allāhumma ighfir lī al-thunūba allatī tahţiku al-ʿişama
english_text: O Allah, forgive me those sins which tear apart safeguards!

arabic_text: اَللَّهُمَ اغْفِرْ لِيَ الذُّنُوبَ الَّتِي تُنْزِلُ النِّقَمَ
transliteration: allāhumma ighfir liya al-dhunūba allatī tunzilu al-niqama
english_text: O Allah, forgive me those sins which draw down adversities!

arabic_text: اَللَّهُمَ اغْفِرْ لِيَ الذُّنُوبَ الَّتِي تُغيِّرُ النِّعَمَ
transliteration: allāhumma ighfirliya al-dhunūb al-latī tughayyiru al-niʿam
english_text: O Allah, forgive me those sins which alter blessings!

arabic_text: اَللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِيَ الذُّنُوبَ الَّتِي تَحْبِسُ الدُّعَاءَ
transliteration: allāhumma ighfir liya dhunūba allatī taḥbisu al-duʿāʾa
english_text: O Allah forgive me those sins which hold back supplication!

arabic_text: اَللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِيَ الذُّنُوبَ الَّتِي تَقْطَعُ الرَّجَاءَ
transliteration: allāhumma ighfir lī al-dhunūba al-latī taqṭaʿu al-rajaʾa
english_text: O Allah forgive me those sins which cut down hopes!

arabic_text: اَللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِيَ الذُّنُوبَ الَّتِي تُنْزِلُ البَلآءَ
transliteration: allāhumma ighfir lī adh-dhunūba allatī tunzilu al-balā'a
english_text: O Allah, forgive me those sins which draw down tribulation!

arabic_text: اَللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِيْ كُلَّ ذَنْبٍ أَذْنَبْتُهُ وَكُلَّ خَطِيئَةٍ أَخْطَأْتُهَا
transliteration: allāhumma ighfir lī kulla dhambin aðnabtuhu wa kulla khaðīʾatin akhţaʾtuhā
english_text: O Allah, forgive me every sin I have committed and every mistake I have made!

arabic_text: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَتَقَرَّبُ إِلَيْكَ بِذِكْرِكَ وَأَسْتَشْفِعُ بِكَ إِلَى نَفْسِكَ وَأَسْألُكَ بِجُودِكَ أَن تُدْنِيَنِي مِن قُرْبِكَ وَأَن تُوزِعَنِي شُكْرَكَ
transliteration: allāhumma innī ataqarrabu ilayka bi dhikrika wa astashfiʿu bika ila nafsika wa as'aluka bi judika an tudniyani min qurbika wa anna tuziʿani shukraka
english_text: O Allah, verily I seek nearness to You through remembrance of You, And I seek intercession from You with Yourself, And I ask You through Your munificence to bring me near to Your proximity, And to provide me with gratitude toward You

arabic_text: وَأَن تُلْهِمَنِي ذِكْرَكَ
transliteration: wa anna tulhimani dhikrak
english_text: And to inspire me with Your remembrance.

arabic_text: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْألُكَ سُؤَالَ خَاضِعٍ مُّتَذَلِّلٍ خَاشِعٍ أَن تُسَامِحَنِي وَتَرْحَمَنِي وَتَجْعَلَنِي بِقَسَمِكَ رَاضِيًا قَانِعًا، وَفِي جَمِيعِ الأَحْوَاِل مُتَوَاضِعًا
transliteration: allāhumma innī as'aluka suāla khādiʿin mutadhallilin khāshiʿin an tusāmihanī wa tarhamanī wa tajʿalani biqasamika rāḍiyan qāniʿan, wa fī jamīʿi al-aḥwāli mutawāḍi
english_text: O Allah, verily I ask You with the asking of a submissive, abased and lowly man to show me forbearance, to have mercy on me And to make me satisfied and content with Your apportionment and humble in every state.

arabic_text: اَللَّهُمَّ وَأَسْألُكَ سُؤَالَ مَنِ اشْتَدَّتْ فَاقَتُهُ وَأَنْزَلَ بِكَ عِنْدَ الشَّدَائِدِ حَاجَتَهُ وَعَظُمَ فِيمَا عِنْدَكَ رَغْبَتُهُ
transliteration: allahumma wa as'aluka su'aala mani ishtaddat faqatuhu wa anzala bika ʿinda ash-shada'id haajatahu wa ʿaẓuma fīmā ʿindaka raghbatahu
english_text: O Allah, I ask You with the asking of one whose indigence is extreme, And who has stated to You in difficulties his need And whose desire for what is with You has become great.

arabic_text: اَللَّهُمَّ عَظُمَ سُلْطَانُكَ وَعَلاَ مَكَانُكَ وَخَفِيَ مَكْرُكَ وَظَهَرَ أَمْرُكَ وَغَلَبَ قَهْرُكَ وَجَرَتْ قُدْرَتُكَ وَلا يُمْكِنُ الْفِرَارُ مِنْ حُكُومَتِكَ
transliteration: allāhumma ʿaẓuma sultaanuka wa ʿalaa makānuka wa khafiyah makrukah wa zahara amruka wa ghala ba qahruka wa jarat qudratuka wala yunkinu al-firaru min hukumatika
english_text: O Allah, Your force is tremendous, Your place is lofty, And Your deception is hidden, Your command is manifest, And Your domination is overwhelming, Your power is unhindered And escape from Your governance is impossible.

arabic_text: اَللَّهُمَّ لا أَجِدُ لِذُنُوبِي غَافِرًا وَلا لِقَبَائِحِي سَاتِرًا وَلا لِشَيٍْء مِّنْ عَمَلِيَ الْقَبِيحِ بِالْحَسَنِ مُبَدِّلاً غَيْرَكَ لا إِلَهَ إِلا أَنْتَ
transliteration: allāhumma lā ʾajidu li‑dhunūbī ghāfirā walā liqabāʾihi sātiran wa lā li-shay'in min 'amalī al-qabīḥ bi-l-ḥasan mubaddiran ghayraka la ilaha illa anta
english_text: O Allah, I find no forgiver of my sins, No concealer of my ugly acts, And no transformer of any of my ugly acts into good acts but You There is no god but You!

arabic_text: سُبْحَانَكَ وَبِحَمْدِكَ
transliteration: subḥānaka wa biḥamdik
english_text: Glory be to You, and Yours is the praise!

arabic_text: ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي وَتَجَرَّأْتُ بِجَهْلِي وَسَكَنْتُ إِلَى قَدِيمِ ذِكْرِكَ لِي وَمَنِّكَ عَلَيَّ
transliteration: ẓalamtu nafsī wa tajarra'atu bi jahli wa sakantu ila qadimi dhikrika li wa mannik alayya
english_text: I have wronged myself, And I have been audacious in my ignorance And I have depended upon Your ancient remembrance of me and Your favour toward me.

arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ مَوْلايَ
transliteration: allāhumma maulāya
english_text: O Allah! O my Protector!

arabic_text: كَمْ مِّنْ قَبِيحٍ سَتَرْتَهُ
transliteration: kam min qabīḥin satar­tahu
english_text: How many ugly things You have concealed!

arabic_text: وَكَمْ مِّن فَاِدحٍ مِّنَ البَلاءِ أَقَلْتَهُ
transliteration: wa kam min fādihin min al-balā'i aqaltahu
english_text: How many burdensome tribulations You have abolished!

arabic_text: وَكَمْ مِّنْ عِثَارٍ وَّقَيْتَهُ
transliteration: wa kam min ʿithārin waqa-ytahu
english_text: And how many stumbles You have prevented!

arabic_text: وَكَمْ مِّن مَّكْرُوهٍ دَفَعْتَهُ
transliteration: wa kam min makroohin dafʿatahu
english_text: And how many ordeals You have repelled!
